wiki.title: Brian Helton
wiki.extract: Brian Helton (born July 27, 1970) is an American politician serving as a Republican member of the West Virginia Senate for the 9th district. He took the oath of office on January 14, 2025. He graduated from college with a Bachelor of Science in business administration, and is a business owner. Helton is a Baptist.
